mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, t.category, t.ratio, t.image, t.accent, t.description, r.required_image_count, r.accepted_mime_types, r.max_file_size_bytes FROM templates t JOIN template_requirements r ON r.template_id = t.id WHERE t.active = TRUE ORDER BY t.id

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.category, t.ratio, t.image, t.accent, t.description, r.required_image_count, r.accepted_mime_types, r.max_file_size_bytes FROM templates t JOIN template_requirements r ON r.template_id = t.id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.active = TRUE

SELECT id, user_id, template_id, template_name, template_image, file_name, source_path, result_path, status, progress, stage, error_message, created_at FROM creation_tasks WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, template_id, template_name, template_image, file_name, source_path, result_path, status, progress, stage, error_message, created_at FROM creation_tasks WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE creation_tasks SET status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, stage = #{stage}, result_path = #{resultPath}, error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE id = #{id}
